name: How do I know if my broken window can be repaired or needs full replacement?

mainEntity.name: How do I know if my broken window can be repaired or needs full replacement?

acceptedAnswer.text: The decision depends on the extent of the damage and the window type. Small cracks or single-pane glass often allow for glass-only replacement. However, if the frame is damaged, the window is a complex style (like a bay or bow window), or it's a double-pane unit with a broken seal, a full window replacement might be more cost-effective and provide better long-term performance. A professional assessment can determine the best solution.
acceptedAnswer.description: Small cracks or single-pane glass often allow repair. Frame damage, complex styles, or broken seals in double-pane units usually require full replacement.
